what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ecuador in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 113622 Ecuadorian asylum seekers in the United States, 93.1% of all asylum seekers from Ecuador.
Refugees from Ecuador, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada and Mexico.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Ecuador and Peru in 1995.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Ecuador in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 121 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
